description: Telit modules (USB 1bc7): LE910 / LE910C, LN940, LM940/LM960, FN980/FN990 and the Foxconn T77 under Telit IDs; QMI, MBIM or ECM data beside option (some LE910 compositions CDC ACM) serial ports. ModemManager owns them (its telit plugin). Models with a profile of their own (LM960, FN990, T77W676/T77W968) win over this family; the rest get a family name and ModemManager instead of the generic profile. Reference only, not on our bench. Sources: ModemManager src/plugins/telit, the imported catalog (21 IDs), another modem manager modem/usb list 3.9.43 (the 1bc7 IDs); the owner, 2026-11-13: family profiles for the vendors that had none

radio.source: the family's AT set as the model profile telit-lm960 documents it (its sources there); under ModemManager the radio is read and set through ModemManager's own plugin, the dialect is for an AT port the engine holds itself
